sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Sin is an Irish heroine. She is a fairy woman. Scholars see her as a remnant of an early goddess. She made wine from water. She made swine from leaves. She fed the warriors she had called up with her spells. She appears in a tale of the king Muircertach mac Erc. Sin seduced the king and drove him mad. She sought to punish him for killing her family when she was a child. Her magic turns his power against him.
